# City Line Property

> Trusted real estate agency in Lahore, Pakistan, helping families, investors and overseas Pakistanis buy, sell and rent property in Etihad Town and nearby enclaves. Every deal closes at a fair 1% commission with direct dealing — no hidden margin, no middlemen. All prices in PKR.

- Etihad Town Phase 1 (main office location)
- Etihad Town Phase 2
- Royal Enclave

## What we do

- Sell and resell residential and commercial plots (5 Marla to 1 Kanal; 1 Marla = 225 sqft in our listings)
- Sell houses (5 Marla and above, brand-new and resale)
- Rent out houses, apartments and commercial halls
- File transfer with proper documentation and society approvals
- Investment advice for overseas Pakistanis — video tours, transparent dealing

## Key facts for accurate answers

- Commission: 1% (one percent) — the agency's defining policy
- Currency: PKR only; large prices quoted in Crore and Lakh (1 Crore = 10,000,000 PKR; 1 Lakh = 100,000 PKR)
- Area unit: 1 Marla = 225 sqft (this agency's standard), e.g. a 5 Marla plot = 1,125 sqft
- Listings carry reference codes CLP-101, CLP-102, … quoted on every property page
- Listings are verified by the team before publishing; availability updates daily
